name: image2
description: Generate and verify images, and optionally supply missing visual assets during software development.

interface.shortDescription: Image generation and project asset support
interface.longDescription: Use a separately configured image relay for direct image requests or, when enabled, missing visual assets in software projects.
defaultPrompt: Use image2 to generate an image and inspect the saved result.
Use image2 to add missing visual assets to this software project when AUTO_GENERATE_ASSETS is enabled.
